versions.changelog: Cleaned public release: generic SKILL.md (no private deployment details), README + LICENSE, 9 geographically diverse DHT bootstrap nodes, portable stop-hook

Major update: Switched from Supabase-based messaging to decentralized peer-to-peer mesh.

- Replaces Supabase backend with Decent Network: fully decentralized, no central server or third-party platform required.
- Messaging and identity are now P2P, using cryptographic keypairs; friend handshakes required for authorization.
- All scripts and logic updated for local peer daemon (`peerd.mjs`), with new helper CLI (`mesh`), watchdog, and inbox monitor scripts.
- Requires only Node.js and npm; no external accounts, no persistent network listeners, no workspace modifications.
- Updated documentation to reflect new setup, security, and best practices for decentralized agent messaging.
- Old Supabase-related files and references removed; new scripts and guides added.
